gloss: one by one; one at a time

definitions.gloss: one by one; one at a time; individually; each
definitions.explanation: Indicates doing something one item at a time, distributing one per person, or progressing step by step. Formed from {一|ひと}つ (one) and ずつ (each, apiece). Expresses methodical, careful, or sequential action.

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}つずつ{確認|かくにん}する。
{問題|もんだい}を{一|ひと}つずつ{解決|かいけつ}していこう。
examples.english: Let's solve the problems one at a time.

examples.japanese: お{菓子|かし}を{子供|こども}たちに{一|ひと}つずつ{配|くば}った。
examples.english: I handed out one sweet to each of the children.

notes:
Composed of {一|ひと}つ (one) and ずつ (each, apiece — a distributive particle). Part of a productive pattern: {二|ふた}つずつ (two at a time), {三|みっ}つずつ (three at a time), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一|ひと}つずつ{確認|かくにん}する: to check one by one
- {一|ひと}つずつ{片付|かたづ}ける: to deal with things one at a time
- {一|ひと}つずつ{丁寧|ていねい}に: carefully, one at a time
- {一|ひと}つずつ{進|すす}める: to proceed step by step

THE ずつ PATTERN:
The particle ずつ attaches to counters and quantity words to express equal distribution or gradual progression:
- {一|いち}{枚|まい}ずつ: one sheet each
- {少|すこ}しずつ: little by little
- {一歩|いっぽ}ずつ: one step at a time
- {三|さん}{人|にん}ずつ: three people per group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一|いっ}{個|こ}ずつ: one piece each — uses a different counter but the same meaning
- {少|すこ}しずつ: little by little — gradual rather than item-by-item
- {順番|じゅんばん}に: in order, in turn — emphasizes sequence rather than quantity
